items.html: And corresponding to these two phases, which are two kabin, the House of Hillel ruled that it is then obligated in Challah, since there is already in them the first kav of carobs, and the second, pure kav is added to it — hence it is obligated in Challah. But the House of Shammai held that since there is one kav, there is already in it a hint of the pure kav, and that suffices. This, too, is the secret of the Mishnah in Tractate Challah (Chapter 4, Mishnah 4): “an old kav and a new kav that bit one another,” etc. And they are two kabin: one old, from the days of the carobs, and one new, in their fullness now, in the days of the pregnancy.
